stop_policy: Stop on first failed stage. No retries, source edits, successor candidate, environment construction, or training after a registered validation failure.
scope: Preparation only. No environment, evaluation, training, gradient computation, PPO update, ledger mutation, lease mutation, or checkpoint mutation.

steps.command: python -B -m unittest -v test_continuation_contract test_launcher_lifecycle test_capsule_support test_outputs

constraints: All commands use the pinned workspace interpreter, -B, PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX set to this new empty absolute directory, and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
No command constructs environments or runs evaluation/training/gradients.
Full-preflight stage mocks only inactive lease assertion; actual launch never mocks lease.
Logs close before hashes are computed.
